text: The purpose of this staff report is to seek City Council approval of the 5 Corporate Drive - Public Art Plan. The Plan, which is included as Attachment 3 of this report, outlines the method by which the owner will commission public art within the privately-owned area of the site. The Public Art Plan provides a framework and description of the commissioning of public art including: project description; history and culture of the area; public art requirement; public art objectives; public art locations; budget; selection process; mentorship opportunity; jury composition and schedule. The attached plan meets the objectives of the City's Percent for Public Art Guidelines and is supported by the Toronto Public Art Commission.

City Council on June 15 and 16, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the 5 Corporate Drive Public Art Plan in Attachment 3 to the report (May 9, 2022) from the Director, Urban Design, City Planning.
